title: Gazipur, Dhaka — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Gazipur, Dhaka: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Gazipur is a city in Dhaka with a population of 1,800,000. A rapidly growing industrial city near Dhaka, home to numerous garment factories and Bangladesh’s only safari park. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 250 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 27.0.
